frontier.hypothesis: An arming loop that costs zero final instructions closes the function outright: it produces the target's exact movable shape (already measured) without the 5 insns the current probe emits.
frontier.mechanism: move_movables moved_once doubling, tools/gcc-2.7.2/loop.c:1609-1611 plus :1912, armed by any loop processed before the main loop (loop_optimize walks loop numbers downward) whose hoisted movable is scanned first in the main loop's movable list.
